Name: Step-In Jab
Effect: Claim Initiative on hit. If you hold Initiative, chain another Attack.

Name: Snap Jab
Effect: Fastest standing punch. Claim Initiative on hit.

Name: Straight Cross
Effect: Deals +1 DMG if chained after a Jab or Feint.

Name: Overhand Right
Effect: Triggers Rocked check on clean hit. Push opponent [Move Out 1].

Name: Lead Left Hook
Effect: If played as 3rd card in Combo, inflicts Rocked automatically.

Name: Ripping Liver Hook
Effect: Reduces opponent Max Stamina Cap by 2 on clean hit.

Name: Short Uppercut
Effect: +3 DMG if opponent plays a Takedown card this exchange.

Name: Slip & Cross
Effect: Evades Head Attack, deals 5 DMG, and steals Initiative.

Name: Pull Counter Cross
Effect: Negates Mid Attack, deals 6 DMG, and steps back to Long Range.

Name: Check Hook
Effect: Beats any [Move In] card. Deals 4 DMG and pivots out.

Name: Shoulder Roll & Feint
Effect: Beats Counter (opponent loses 3 Stamina). Draw 1 card; next Attack +1 SPD.

Name: Tight High Guard
Effect: Blocks up to 6 Head DMG. Recover +2 Stamina.

Name: Inside Calf Kick
Effect: Inflicts 1 Leg Injury (-1 SPD to opponent) on clean hit.

Name: Teep (Push Kick)
Effect: Stops [Move In] attacks and pushes Range back 1 zone.

Name: Switch Body Kick
Effect: Deals 3 DMG even if blocked by High Guard. Drains 2 opponent Stamina.

Name: Question Mark Head Kick
Effect: Ignores Defend cards if you played a Feint or Body/Leg Kick last turn.

Name: Step-In Standing Elbow
Effect: Opens an Eye Cut on clean hit (opponent reveals 1 hand card).

Name: Spinning Back Elbow
Effect: Triggers Rocked check. If countered or blocked, lose 3 extra Stamina.

Name: Flying Knee
Effect: +4 DMG vs Takedowns. If missed/blocked, opponent gets free Takedown.

Name: Thai Plum Clinch Entry
Effect: Transitions to Clinch with Dominant Collar Tie (+2 DMG to Clinch Knees).

Name: Clinch Knee to Liver
Effect: Deals 5 Body DMG and drains 3 opponent Stamina.

Name: Shin Check
Effect: Blocks Leg/Body Kicks and reflects 2 Leg DMG back to attacker.

Name: Catch Kick & Sweep
Effect: Negates Body/Leg Kick, deals 3 DMG, and transitions to Closed Guard (Top).

Name: Feint Teep / Switch Step
Effect: Beats Counter. Shift Range 1 zone in either direction and draw 1 card.

Name: Blast Double-Leg
Effect: Beats Feint/High Guard. Moves to Half Guard (Top) and deals 2 slam DMG.

Name: Low Single-Leg
Effect: Evades High Punches/Head Kicks. Moves to Closed Guard (Top).

Name: Cage Drag Single
Effect: From Clinch, transitions to Side Control (Top). +2 SPD if opponent Cage Space <= 1.

Name: Inside Trip (Ouchi Gari)
Effect: Fast clinch trip. Transitions directly to Half Guard (Top).

Name: Hip Toss (Harai Goshi)
Effect: Beats [Move In] strikes or Clinch attacks. Deals 4 slam DMG and lands in Side Control (Top).

Name: Mat Return Slam
Effect: Punishes Stand-Up/Escape attempts. Deals 4 Body DMG and keeps Back Control.

Name: Level-Change Fake
Effect: Beats Counter/Sprawl (opponent loses 3 Stamina). Chain an Overhand or Takedown.

Name: Heavy Sprawl
Effect: Stops any Takedown, drains 3 attacker Stamina, and claims Initiative.

Name: Granby Roll Escape
Effect: From Side Control or Half Guard Bottom, escapes back to Standing (Mid Range).

Name: Smothering Top Ride
Effect: Prevents opponent Sweep/Escape, drains 2 opponent Stamina, and keeps Initiative.

Name: Guard Pull
Effect: Voluntarily pulls fight to Closed Guard (you on Bottom) with Initiative.

Name: Knee-Slice Guard Pass
Effect: Advances Top position by 1 step (Closed -> Half -> Side Control) and keeps Initiative.

Name: Toreando Pass to Mount
Effect: Advances directly to Full Mount (Top) with maximum positional dominance.

Name: Back Take (Berimbolo)
Effect: Transitions directly to Back Control (Top) from Guard or Side Control.

Name: Scissor Sweep
Effect: Reverses Top opponent's Pass or GnP, flipping position to Full Mount (Top).

Name: Upa Bridge Reversal
Effect: When mounted, counters a Ground & Pound strike to reverse into Closed Guard (Top).

Name: Rear-Naked Choke
Effect: Drains 6 Stamina. If defender hits 0 Stamina, win by Submission immediately.

Name: Spinning Armbar
Effect: Deals 5 Limb DMG (reduces Punch DMG by 2). Submits if Limb DMG >= 10 or 0 Stamina.

Name: Triangle Choke
Effect: Playable from Bottom Guard. Drains 5 Stamina; Submits at 0 Stamina.

Name: Jumping Guillotine
Effect: Counters a Double/Single Leg, pulls to Guard, and drains 5 Stamina.

Name: Inside Heel Hook
Effect: Deals 6 Leg DMG (-2 SPD). Submits immediately if Leg DMG >= 10.

Name: Shrimp & Hip Escape
Effect: Improves your bottom position by 1 step (Mount -> Side -> Half -> Closed Guard).

Name: Hammerfist Barrage
Effect: Deals 4 Head DMG (+2 DMG if in Mount or Back Control).

Name: Crucifix Ground Elbows
Effect: Deals 6 Head DMG, opens an Eye Cut, and triggers a Rocked check.

Name: Cut the Cage
Effect: Reduces opponent's Cage Space Dial by 1. Claim Initiative.

Name: Circle Out & Reset
Effect: Moves Range back 1 zone, restores +2 Cage Space, and resets Initiative to Neutral.

Name: Read Tendencies
Effect: Look at opponent's hand, draw 2 cards, and gain +2 SPD on your next exchange.

Name: Deep Breath & Pace
Effect: Recover +5 Stamina and clear the Rocked condition.
